page.overview:
Who is Master Jai?

Master Jai was a minor character who appeared in the Mortal Kombat: Conquest series in the episode entitled “Immortal Kombat”. He was portrayed by Ben Lin.

Master Jai was a monk who served in the Temple of the Order of Light. After one of his fellow monks (Master Hwang) was killed by dark powers of sorcery Kung Lao helped him investigate. They figured out that the cause of Hwang's death was drinking from Lao's water sack, which had been spiked with a potion that would cause the victim to rapidly age and deteriorate, even after death.

They then realized that Siro and Taja have the water sack and were probably drinking the remainder of the potion that caused Hwang to age into oblivion, and will do the same to them.

Jai told Kung Lao of a woman, Omegis, a sorceress who has defeated mortality and can reverse the effects of Shang Tsung’s potion. Unfortunately, he warned, Omegis is a friend to no one and only serves her own desires.
